name: What should I prepare before signing a 'Cancel Anytime Listing Agreement'?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before signing a 'Cancel Anytime Listing Agreement'?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before signing, you should gather all relevant property documents, such as previous appraisals, survey reports, and any records of home improvements. Also, clearly define your selling goals and expectations regarding communication and marketing strategies. This preparation ensures you can make an informed decision and discuss all terms thoroughly. Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution will review these details with you to tailor a strategy for your specific property and objectives.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare property documents, define selling goals, and clarify expectations regarding communication and marketing strategies before signing.
